|rulings=* If the droid is persona replaced, [[A Gift]] transfers to the new version, who remains an [[Undercover]] spy.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=A%20Gift</ref>
* The droid prevents the opponent from Force draining at same site, and allows the owner to deploy to same site even without presence or Force icons.
* The droid is inactive (for example it does not participate in battles) but outside of battle it may be targeted by Interrupts and anything that could make it hit or lost.
* Light may voluntarily break cover during their deploy phase.
* If the droid's cover is broken (either voluntarily or by another card such as [[Lt. Pol Treidum]]), then [[A Gift]] is lost.
